title: About Us
subtitle: Meet the team behind the world's best first aid kit management app.

intro.title: Who are we?
intro.paragraph1: We're a startup that believes your home first aid kit deserves enterprise-class management. We help you control medication inventory, track expiration dates, and make better health decisions — simply, conveniently, and without wasting money.
